As secular communities continue to articulate a human-centered moral understanding that doesn't need cosmic endorsements, will likely stand in stark contrast to these superficial religious tactics. The global conversation on religion and meaning may well pivot around which approach proves more honest, constructive, and beneficial to the human condition. By exploring these insights, we see the ripple effect, how endorsement Christianity not only distorts what it means to be a believer, but also undercuts the potential for true moral leadership.
